operators.name: instance_norm_forward
semantics: Computes instance normalization over spatial dimensions H and W for each sample and channel separately.
mean = mean(x[n, c, :, :]) over the last two dimensions; var = biased variance over the same dimensions.
If weight is not None, multiply per-channel weight broadcast along channel dimension; if bias is not None, add per-channel bias broadcast along channel dimension.
The operation is performed in float32 on CUDA; output has same shape as input.
weight and bias parameters may be None if affine=False; the custom op must handle None appropriately.
Applies instance normalization as described; output shape [16,3,2048,1024], float32.
